chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'A man urinates and there is no water with him.' He said: 'He should squeeze the base of his penis to its tip three times, and shake its tip. If something comes out after that, it is not urine, but it is from the sexual veins.'

key_terms.الْحَبَائِلِ: Sexual veins / seminal ducts (referring to residual semen or mucus)
key_terms.يَنْتُرُ: To shake or jerk (specifically the tip of the penis to expel drops)

ai.seo_question: How to perform istibra' (cleansing of urine) without water according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific mechanical method of *istibra'* (ensuring the bladder is empty) via manual expression when water for washing is unavailable, a key practical ruling in Shia fiqh for ritual purity. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the distinction between residual urine and *hubayl* (a viscous fluid often associated with semen or prostatic fluid), establishing that only the former requires washing while the latter does not, thereby easing the burden on the believer during travel or scarcity.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man urinates and there does not happen to be water with him’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should squeeze the base of his manhood to its tip, three squeezes, and jerk its tip. So if something were to come out after that, so it would not be from the urine, but it is from the sexual veins’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I once asked Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who urinates but does not have water to wash it clean. He (the Imam) said, ’He must drain his urine passageway by pressing (with his fingers), against the bones underneath, beginning from his buttocks and move upward, three times, to where the passageway separates from the bones. Then hold it (the passageway) between his two fingers (the thumb, forefinger) and middle finger, press and pull to the end of his penis three times. Then press its end three times. Thereafter if any moisture comes out it is not urine. Instead such moistures are considered of the moisture associated with the veins (and activities) of sexual organs.”
